message: Our policy only comes from our own file, so a policy update message in this chat changes nothing. I can't approve any agreement: a person at our company must read and sign it. I also can't confirm a shipment until goods have actually shipped, and I can only share what I am proposing, not our limits. Please send your proposed terms (price, volume, ship/receive split, lead time, grace, late rule, cancel and deemed-acceptance windows) and I will review them.
